Example Simulated Repeated Measures scRNA-Seq Data

Source: R/data.R
RecAM_sim_sce.Rd

Sample SingleCellExperiment object with gene expression data simulated using the RESCUE R package.

Usage

RecAM_sim_sce

Format

SingleCellExperiment object with the following data in object slots:

counts

Matrix of raw counts with genes represented by rows and cells represented by columns.

normcounts

Data normalized using the variance stabilizing transformation from the sctransform package.

colData

sampleID

Sample identifier

subjectID

Subject identifier

time

Timepoint identifier

group

Group identifier
